Entity and schema correction so the business is typed as what it is, not as a Product
Answer architecture: FAQ and definition pages that mirror the visible page

Source-linked observation report and one consolidated revision

finding_241.title: Has outbound started? Yes. Two waves, 241 sends, zero verified human replies.
finding_241.detail: Gmail SENT reconciled on September 3: 41 wave-one and 200 wave-two messages from dillonmohr8777@gmail.com to Erie and Pittsburgh businesses, 241 unique recipients, two bounces, two auto-replies, zero verified human replies. The absence of a bounce is not proof of delivery. No further send is authorised by that plan.
finding_241.contrast: In the same fortnight, two hand-built AI search audits sent to GT Clinic and Tuxedo Den both reached the quote stage.
finding_241.implication: The opener that works is the audit, not the cold email. The Snapshot generator makes the audit repeatable. Reporting for any future outbound must be defined before the first send, or the result is not accountable. Decision D10.

discovery: What process is costing time or losing attention? Who owns it and who approves a change? Ask for one recent concrete example.
Walk one item from intake to completion. Which systems, fields, handoffs and exceptions exist? What happens after a failure?
How often does this occur? Get an actual count and sample period, and approximate human effort. Mark estimates as estimates. Which business outcome matters?
Who grants access, validates records and uses the result? What must never happen? What data or contractual restrictions apply?
Select one finite pilot. Explain exclusions, test and acceptance approach, proposed price and support boundary. Ask what would make it a bad purchase.
Confirm next step, owner, missing evidence and date. No readiness or willingness-to-pay claim until the buyer actually states it.

scoring.rule: 0 to 2 each. A zero in relationship, access or adoption prevents a build commitment. 8 to 10 supports scoped proposal preparation. 5 to 7 means paid discovery or evidence collection. Below 5 means defer.
scoring.caveat: This is an internal prioritisation rule, not a validated predictor of sales.

disqualify: Wants three CRMs and unlimited changes for the one-workflow fee
Asks to misrepresent a prospect site as the official live business site
disqualify_note: A low lead count alone is not a disqualification if the process is valuable and measurable.
objections: We already have a CRM.
We start with it. The pilot fixes one handoff rather than selling a replacement.
Can't I just buy an AI subscription?
Yes. This fee covers mapping, implementation, tests, operator training and bounded support.
Will this create more leads?
This pilot improves handling. Lead-generation results require separate evidence.
What if it sends something wrong?
Replies stay internal drafts until a separately approved sending policy exists.
What if the API fails?
Work pauses or enters the exception queue. Ambiguous writes are reconciled before retry.
Is our data used for training?
We verify the selected provider's current contract and settings before using real data. We do not promise an unverified policy.
Why the setup fee?
It funds mapping, implementation, failure testing and handoff for the finite scope.
Can you do everything this week?
We commit dates after access and capacity checks. The initial implementation is not guaranteed within a week.
Who owns it if you leave?
The proposal must specify accounts, code and IP rights, configuration and handoff before sale.
Can we cancel?
Renewal, cancellation, transition assistance and data return or deletion terms are written into the agreement.

economics.assumptions: $75 loaded labour/hour, 10% sales allowance, $500 fixed monthly allowance, per-offer tool allowances of $75 (AEO), $100 (Motion), $150 (Lead Ops), full collection. Same method as the September 4 pack's economics.py.
economics.math: Recurring: 750 + 1,250 + 1,500 = 3,500. Hours 4 + 6 + 6 = 16 at $75 = 1,200. Tools 325. Gross 1,975. Sales 350. Fixed 500. Contribution 1,125. At double hours: gross 775, contribution negative 75. Spec build once: 3,500 - 1,800 labour - 100 tools - 350 sales = 1,250 before fixed cost. Rows on the page are produced by economics_v2.py through the September 4 pack's engine, not typed.
economics.caveat: These are calculations under assumptions, not actual revenue and not net profit. Booked, invoiced and collected stay separate totals. Missing collections stay unknown, not assumed paid. Double hours takes the recurring cohort below zero, which is why hours per client is an acceptance metric of every offer.
